title: ZA-2026-1712-CUB-1A
text:
ZA-2026-1712-CUB-1A  Council District: 1 – Hernandez
  CEQA: ENV-2026-1713-CE  Last Day to Act: 11-16-26
  Plan Area: Westlake

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  1512 – 1514 West Pico Boulevard

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Conditional Use Permit to allow the sale of a full line of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption in
  conjunction with a proposed 3,808 square-foot boutique bottle shop. Proposed hours of operation are from
  8:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m., daily.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the August 18, 2026 Zoning Administrator’s Determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15305, Class 5
  (Minor Alterations in Land Use Limitations), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an
  exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Approved, pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.24 W.1 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, a Conditional
  Use Permit to allow the sale of a full line of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption in conjunction
  with a proposed 3,808 square foot boutique bottle/retail shop with hours of operation from 8:00 a.m. to
  2:00 a.m., daily, in the CM-1 Zone; and
  3. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Eddie Shamas, Sipsy Pico Inc.
  Representative: Jason Kho, AAA Liquor License Consulting

  Appellant:  Aurora M. Corona

  Staff:  Esther Ahn, City Planner
  esther.ahn@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1486

  Henry Chu, Associate Zoning Administrator
summary: An appeal of the zoning administrator's approval of a conditional use permit for off-site sales of full-line alcohol at a planned 3,808 sq ft bottle shop at 1512-1514 West Pico Boulevard in Westlake, open 8 a.m. to 2 a.m. daily.
